rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a neutral position or nonalignment, especially in a dispute or conflict.

example.english: We stay neutral throughout this dispute.
example.traditional: 我哋喺呢場爭論入面保持中立。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ni1 coeng4 zang1 leon6 jap6 min6 bou2 ci4 zung1 lap6

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when describing a person who does not favor either side or person; 中立 is better for a formal stance.

example.english: Mum is always neutral between her two sons and never favors either one.
example.traditional: 阿媽對兩個仔一向唔偏心。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 deoi3 loeng5 go3 zai2 jat1 hoeng3 m4 pin1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a rating, tone, category, or response that is neither positive nor negative.

example.english: This rating is neutral: it is neither good nor bad.
example.traditional: 呢個評分好中性，唔算好亦唔算差。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 fan1 hou2 zung1 sing3 m4 syun3 hou2 jik6 m4 syun3 caa1

rows.note: Use this for an object or particle with no electric charge, rather than for a neutral opinion or attitude.

example.english: This wire carries no electric charge, so it is neutral and safe to touch.
example.traditional: 呢條電線唔帶電，你可以放心掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 din6 sin3 m4 daai3 din6 nei5 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 dim3
